profile.title: 英格蘭 16 歲後的選擇
profile.subtitle: 根據學習內容、申請條件和可能的下一步比較路徑。
profile.excerpt: 瞭解 A levels、T Levels 和學徒制的區別，再確認與你有關的實際課程、職缺和後續發展條件。
profile.hero_quote: 比較學習內容。確認條件。保留備選。

sections.title: 概覽
sections.body_md:
16 歲時選擇下一步，意味著要比較你將學習什麼或在工作中做什麼、能滿足哪些申請條件，以及之後可能想做什麼。本專題介紹 A levels、T Levels 和學徒制，幫助你查找實際選項，而不只是根據路徑名稱做選擇。

本指南適用於英格蘭。你必須繼續接受教育或培訓，直到年滿 18 歲，但這並不要求你一直留在學校。全日制教育和學徒制都是可選路徑；另一種選擇是每週工作或從事志工服務至少 20 小時，同時參加非全日制教育或培訓。此處討論的三條路徑只是更廣泛選擇中的一部分。[National Careers Service：離校後的選擇](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

sections.title: 關鍵概念
sections.body_md:
### A levels：學科組合

大多數學生選擇三門 A level 學科，也可以更多或更少。每門 A level 都屬於 Level 3 資格。把你想學習的學科與未來可能的職務或升學課程所要求的學科進行比較，再確認學校或學院的確切入學條件。[Skills for Careers：A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

### T Levels：技術領域與以課堂學習為主

T Level 是兩年制課程，學習量大致相當於三門 A levels。它將以課堂為主的學習與必修的產業實習相結合。要考察實際技術資格和職業專門方向，而不是假設某個廣泛職業領域中的所有課程都涉及相同工作。[DfE：T Levels 簡介](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/introduction-of-t-levels/introduction-of-t-levels) 和 [DfE：T Level 選擇和專門方向](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

### 學徒制：結合培訓的工作

學徒制將帶薪受僱工作與職務相關的培訓、學習相結合。開始時，你必須年滿 16 歲、居住在英格蘭，且不在接受全日制教育；你可以在仍然就讀學校時申請。學徒制有不同級別，因此在與課程比較前，請確認職缺的職責、標準、級別及包含的資格。[GOV.UK：學徒制如何運作](https://www.gov.uk/become-apprentice)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

sections.title: 為什麼重要
sections.body_md:
**每個選項都有各自的申請條件。** 請向開課單位確認 A level 各學科的要求。T Level 學校和學院自行設定 GCSE 條件，學徒制職缺也可能要求特定資格。在確認具體課程或職務之前，你是否具備申請資格，以及是否有名額，都仍然未知。[Skills for Careers：A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels)、[T Levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/t-levels) 和[學徒制](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/apprenticeships)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

**學習量或分數無法保證該資格會被採認。** 大學和學院自行設定要求，有 UCAS 分數的資格也需符合各校的要求。請確認你正在考慮的每門課程接受的確切資格、學科或專門方向，以及成績。[UCAS：Tariff 分數和入學要求](https://www.ucas.com/applying/before-you-apply/what-and-where-to-study/entry-requirements/calculate-your-ucas-tariff-points)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

**改變方向可能需要額外時間。** 對於 T Levels，開課單位在決定能否轉入或是否需要重新開始時，會考慮課程內容的重合程度，以及距離考核還剩多少時間。一個 T Level 技術資格的學習成果不能計入另一個。請就任何擬議變更諮詢相關開課單位；對於 A levels 或學徒制，要獲取學校、僱主或培訓單位的具體安排，而不是假設學習成果會沿用。[DfE：T Level 選擇和轉入](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

保留一個已經確認申請、交通和時間條件的備選。如果成績或計畫改變，就藉助教師、擬申請的課程或培訓單位，或職業顧問的支援，重新考慮你的選項。[National Careers Service：重新考慮你的選擇](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

sections.title: 適合誰閱讀
sections.body_md:
本專題面向居住在英格蘭、正在考慮 16 歲時下一步選擇的學生，以及幫助他們比較教育和培訓選項的家長或其他支持者。

從自己的興趣、現有資格和實際限制出發，然後：

1. 找出值得進一步了解的實際學科組合、T Level 課程或學徒制職缺。
2. 詢問確切申請條件、課程內容或職務職責、考核，以及學習或培訓時間表。
3. 確認交通、實習或工作要求、相關後續發展要求，以及改變方向的安排。
4. 在作出承諾前，確認申請截止日期和可行的備選方案。

對於尚未得到答覆的問題，在負責的學校、學院、僱主、培訓單位或招生團隊答覆之前，都將其記錄為未知。如果你需要幫助來重新考慮計畫，請與教師、擬申請的課程或培訓單位，或職業顧問交流。[National Careers Service：16 歲後選擇的支援](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16)，查核日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

相關閱讀可幫助你探索工作活動與興趣。興趣反思不能證明課程申請資格、資格是否被接受，也不能確定你應該選擇哪條教育路徑。

**资格的学习量或分数不能证明会被接受。** 大学和学院自行设定要求，并不必须因为一项资格具有 UCAS 分数就接受它。请核实你正在考虑的每门课程接受的确切资格、学科或专门方向，以及成绩。[UCAS：Tariff 分数和入学要求](https://www.ucas.com/applying/before-you-apply/what-and-where-to-study/entry-requirements/calculate-your-ucas-tariff-points)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

从自己的兴趣、现有资格和实际限制出发，然后：

1. 找出值得调查的实际学科组合、T Level 课程或学徒制招聘岗位。
2. 询问确切申请条件、课程内容或岗位职责、考核，以及学习或培训时间表。

本指南适用于英格兰。你必须继续接受教育或培训，直到年满 18 岁，但这并不要求你一直留在学校。全日制教育和学徒制都是可选路径；另一种选择是每周工作或从事志愿服务至少 20 小时，同时参加非全日制教育或培训。此处讨论的三条路径只是更广泛选择中的一部分。[National Careers Service：离校后的选择](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

大多数学生选择三门 A level 学科，也可以更多或更少。每门 A level 都属于 Level 3 资格。把你想学习的学科与未来可能的岗位或深造课程所要求的学科进行比较，再核实学校或学院的确切入学条件。[Skills for Careers：A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

T Level 是两年制课程，学习量大致相当于三门 A levels。它将以课堂为主的学习与必修的行业实习相结合。要考察实际技术资格和职业专门方向，而不是假设某个广泛职业领域中的所有课程都涉及相同工作。[DfE：T Levels 简介](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/introduction-of-t-levels/introduction-of-t-levels) 和 [DfE：T Level 选择和专门方向](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

profile.title: Post-16 options in England
profile.subtitle: Compare routes by their learning, entry conditions and possible next steps.
profile.excerpt: Understand the differences between A levels, T Levels and apprenticeships, then check the actual courses, vacancies and progression conditions that matter to you.
profile.hero_quote: Compare the learning. Check the conditions. Keep a backup.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body_md:
Choosing your next step at 16 means comparing what you would study or do at work, which entry conditions you can meet, and what you might want to do afterwards. This topic introduces A levels, T Levels and apprenticeships so you can investigate actual options rather than choose from route labels alone.

This guidance covers England. You must continue in education or training until you turn 18, but that does not require staying at school. Full-time education and apprenticeships are among the options; another is working or volunteering for at least 20 hours a week alongside part-time education or training. The three routes discussed here are part of that wider choice. [National Careers Service: options after leaving school](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16), checked 14 October 2026.

sections.title: Key concepts
sections.body_md:
### A levels: a combination of subjects

Most students choose three A level subjects, although more or fewer are possible. Each A level is a Level 3 qualification. Compare subjects you want to study with any subjects required for a possible job or further course, then check the school's or college's exact entry conditions. [Skills for Careers: A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels), checked 14 October 2026.

### T Levels: a technical area with substantial college learning

A T Level is a two-year programme, broadly equivalent in size to three A levels. It combines predominantly classroom-based learning with a compulsory industry placement. Examine the actual technical qualification and occupational specialism, rather than assume that every course in a broad career area covers the same work. [DfE: introduction to T Levels](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/introduction-of-t-levels/introduction-of-t-levels) and [DfE: T Level choices and specialisms](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027), checked 14 October 2026.

### Apprenticeships: a job with training

An apprenticeship combines paid employment with training and study related to the role. To start, you must be at least 16, live in England and be outside full-time education; you can apply while still at school. Apprenticeships have different levels, so check the vacancy's duties, standard, level and included qualifications before comparing it with a course. [GOV.UK: how apprenticeships work](https://www.gov.uk/become-apprentice), checked 14 October 2026.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body_md:
**Entry conditions belong to actual options.** Check A level subject requirements with the provider. T Level schools and colleges set their own GCSE conditions, and apprenticeship vacancies may require particular qualifications. Until you check the named course or vacancy, your eligibility and the availability of a place remain unknown. [Skills for Careers: A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels), [T Levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/t-levels) and [apprenticeships](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/apprenticeships), checked 14 October 2026.

**A qualification's size or points do not establish acceptance.** Universities and colleges set their own requirements and do not have to accept a qualification because it has UCAS points. Check the exact qualification, subjects or specialism and grades accepted by each course you are considering. [UCAS: Tariff points and entry requirements](https://www.ucas.com/applying/before-you-apply/what-and-where-to-study/entry-requirements/calculate-your-ucas-tariff-points), checked 14 October 2026.

**Changing direction can require additional time.** For T Levels, providers consider curriculum overlap and the time remaining before assessments when deciding whether a transfer is possible or a restart is needed. Attainment from one T Level technical qualification cannot count towards another. Ask the relevant provider about any proposed change; for A levels or an apprenticeship, obtain the school, employer or training provider's specific arrangements rather than assume learning will carry over. [DfE: T Level choices and transfers](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027), checked 14 October 2026.

Keep a backup whose entry, travel and timing conditions you have checked. If results or plans change, use support from teachers, prospective providers or careers advisers to reconsider your options. [National Careers Service: rethinking your options](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16), checked 14 October 2026.

sections.title: Who should read
sections.body_md:
This topic is for students in England considering their next step at 16, and for parents or other supporters helping them compare education and training options.

Start with your own interests, current qualifications and practical constraints, then:

1. Identify actual subject combinations, T Level courses or apprenticeship vacancies worth investigating.
2. Ask about exact entry conditions, course content or job duties, assessment and the learning or training schedule.
3. Check travel, placement or working commitments, relevant progression requirements and arrangements for changing direction.
4. Confirm application deadlines and a workable alternative before committing.

Record unanswered questions as unknown until the responsible school, college, employer, training provider or admissions team answers them. If you need help reconsidering your plans, speak with your teachers, prospective providers or a careers adviser. [National Careers Service: support with post-16 choices](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16), checked 14 October 2026.

The related reading supports exploration of work activities and interests. Interest reflection cannot establish course eligibility, qualification acceptance or which education route you should take.

**资格的学习量或分数不能证明会被接受。** 大学和学院自行设定要求，并不必须因为一项资格具有 UCAS 分数就接受它。请核实你正在考虑的每门课程接受的确切资格、学科或专门方向，以及成绩。[UCAS：Tariff 分数和入学要求](https://www.ucas.com/applying/before-you-apply/what-and-where-to-study/entry-requirements/calculate-your-ucas-tariff-points)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

**改变方向可能需要额外时间。** 对于 T Levels，课程提供方在决定能否转入或是否需要重新开始时，会考虑课程内容的重合程度，以及距离考核还剩多少时间。一个 T Level 技术资格的学习成果不能计入另一个。请就任何拟议变更咨询相关课程提供方；对于 A levels 或学徒制，要获取学校、雇主或培训提供方的具体安排，而不是假设学习成果会沿用。[DfE：T Level 选择和转入](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

保留一个已经核实申请、出行和时间条件的备选。如果成绩或计划改变，就借助教师、拟申请的课程或培训提供方，或职业顾问的支持，重新考虑你的选项。[National Careers Service：重新考虑你的选择](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

sections.title: 适合谁阅读
sections.body_md:
本专题面向居住在英格兰、正在考虑 16 岁时下一步选择的学生，以及帮助他们比较教育和培训选项的家长或其他支持者。

从自己的兴趣、现有资格和实际限制出发，然后：

1. 找出值得调查的实际学科组合、T Level 课程或学徒制招聘岗位。
2. 询问确切申请条件、课程内容或岗位职责、考核，以及学习或培训时间表。
3. 核实出行、实习或工作要求、相关后续发展要求，以及改变方向的安排。
4. 在作出承诺前，确认申请截止日期和可行的替代选项。

对于尚未得到答复的问题，在负责的学校、学院、雇主、培训提供方或招生团队答复之前，都将其记录为未知。如果你需要帮助来重新考虑计划，请与教师、拟申请的课程或培训提供方，或职业顾问交流。[National Careers Service：16 岁后选择的支持](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16)，核查日期：2026 年 10 月 14 日。

相关阅读支持探索工作活动和兴趣。兴趣反思不能证明课程申请资格、资格是否被接受，也不能确定你应该选择哪条教育路径。

english_snapshot.subtitle: Compare routes by their learning, entry conditions and possible next steps.
english_snapshot.excerpt: Understand the differences between A levels, T Levels and apprenticeships, then check the actual courses, vacancies and progression conditions that matter to you.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body_md:
Choosing your next step at 16 means comparing what you would study or do at work, which entry conditions you can meet, and what you might want to do afterwards. This topic introduces A levels, T Levels and apprenticeships so you can investigate actual options rather than choose from route labels alone.

This guidance covers England. You must continue in education or training until you turn 18, but that does not require staying at school. Full-time education and apprenticeships are among the options; another is working or volunteering for at least 20 hours a week alongside part-time education or training. The three routes discussed here are part of that wider choice. [National Careers Service: options after leaving school](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16), checked 14 October 2026.

sections.title: Key concepts
sections.body_md:
### A levels: a combination of subjects

Most students choose three A level subjects, although more or fewer are possible. Each A level is a Level 3 qualification. Compare subjects you want to study with any subjects required for a possible job or further course, then check the school's or college's exact entry conditions. [Skills for Careers: A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels), checked 14 October 2026.

### T Levels: a technical area with substantial college learning

A T Level is a two-year programme, broadly equivalent in size to three A levels. It combines predominantly classroom-based learning with a compulsory industry placement. Examine the actual technical qualification and occupational specialism, rather than assume that every course in a broad career area covers the same work. [DfE: introduction to T Levels](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/introduction-of-t-levels/introduction-of-t-levels) and [DfE: T Level choices and specialisms](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027), checked 14 October 2026.

### Apprenticeships: a job with training

An apprenticeship combines paid employment with training and study related to the role. To start, you must be at least 16, live in England and be outside full-time education; you can apply while still at school. Apprenticeships have different levels, so check the vacancy's duties, standard, level and included qualifications before comparing it with a course. [GOV.UK: how apprenticeships work](https://www.gov.uk/become-apprentice), checked 14 October 2026.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body_md:
**Entry conditions belong to actual options.** Check A level subject requirements with the provider. T Level schools and colleges set their own GCSE conditions, and apprenticeship vacancies may require particular qualifications. Until you check the named course or vacancy, your eligibility and the availability of a place remain unknown. [Skills for Careers: A levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/a-levels), [T Levels](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/t-levels) and [apprenticeships](https://www.skillsforcareers.education.gov.uk/pages/training-choice/apprenticeships), checked 14 October 2026.

**A qualification's size or points do not establish acceptance.** Universities and colleges set their own requirements and do not have to accept a qualification because it has UCAS points. Check the exact qualification, subjects or specialism and grades accepted by each course you are considering. [UCAS: Tariff points and entry requirements](https://www.ucas.com/applying/before-you-apply/what-and-where-to-study/entry-requirements/calculate-your-ucas-tariff-points), checked 14 October 2026.

**Changing direction can require additional time.** For T Levels, providers consider curriculum overlap and the time remaining before assessments when deciding whether a transfer is possible or a restart is needed. Attainment from one T Level technical qualification cannot count towards another. Ask the relevant provider about any proposed change; for A levels or an apprenticeship, obtain the school, employer or training provider's specific arrangements rather than assume learning will carry over. [DfE: T Level choices and transfers](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/t-level-funding/t-levels-funding-guide-2026-to-2027), checked 14 October 2026.

Keep a backup whose entry, travel and timing conditions you have checked. If results or plans change, use support from teachers, prospective providers or careers advisers to reconsider your options. [National Careers Service: rethinking your options](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16), checked 14 October 2026.

sections.title: Who should read
sections.body_md:
This topic is for students in England considering their next step at 16, and for parents or other supporters helping them compare education and training options.

Start with your own interests, current qualifications and practical constraints, then:

1. Identify actual subject combinations, T Level courses or apprenticeship vacancies worth investigating.
2. Ask about exact entry conditions, course content or job duties, assessment and the learning or training schedule.
3. Check travel, placement or working commitments, relevant progression requirements and arrangements for changing direction.
4. Confirm application deadlines and a workable alternative before committing.

Record unanswered questions as unknown until the responsible school, college, employer, training provider or admissions team answers them. If you need help reconsidering your plans, speak with your teachers, prospective providers or a careers adviser. [National Careers Service: support with post-16 choices](https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk/careers-advice/career-choices-at-16), checked 14 October 2026.

The related reading supports exploration of work activities and interests. Interest reflection cannot establish course eligibility, qualification acceptance or which education route you should take.
